candidate_name: Ajaokuta mini-LNG cluster (Prime LNG, NGML/Gasnexus LNG, BUA LNG, LNG Arete, Highland LNG)
sponsor_or_proposer: NNPC Ltd (stakes: Prime 90%, NGML/Gasnexus 50% w/ Axxela, BUA 10%); plus LNG Arete and Highland LNG
current_state: Groundbreaking ceremony held 3 Feb 2025 at Ajaokuta, Kogi State for five small-scale/mini-LNG plants aimed at domestic gas distribution (e.g. Gasnexus phased 7.5 -> 20 MMSCFD). These are virtual-pipeline/domestic mini-LNG (well under ~0.2 mtpa each), not LNG export terminals.
missing_threshold_elements: Likely below the Global Gas Infrastructure Tracker's LNG-terminal scope (tiny domestic mini-LNG, MMSCFD-scale, not import/export marine terminals). Individual plant capacities, exact locations within Ajaokuta, and whether any qualify as trackable terminals are unconfirmed.
watch_for: Whether any of these scale up or are reclassified as in-scope LNG terminals; confirm whether GEM tracks domestic mini-LNG at all before adding. Re-check capacities against the tracker threshold.
notes: Distinct from Riverside LNG (often confused). Surfaced incidentally while verifying Riverside; flagged for scoping rather than added, per the sweep's conservative add-bar and likely sub-threshold size.
